L338@P7: In this section, we summarize the lessons from our study and make recommendations for future work.
L339@P7: (L1) Models with temporal abstraction can be extremely effective in learning from human

L342@P7: not take temporal context into account.
L343@P7: (L2) Need to improve the ability of batch (offline) RL to learn from suboptimal human datasets.
L344@P7: Sec 4.2 and Appendix I demonstrated that state-of-the-art batch RL algorithms are excellent at
L345@P7: learning from suboptimal machine-generated datasets but much worse at learning from suboptimal
L346@P7: human datasets. They even struggled with a diagnostic dataset with paired good and bad human
L347@P7: demonstration trajectories while IRIS was able to improve slightly on BC-RNN, suggesting that
L348@P7: combining history-dependence with value learning might be a good place to start for improving batch
